design.endState: Existing empty token owner supplies a bounded int view for dense heads until matching returns, then the same owner transfers to greedy/main parsing. One ref-struct heads accessor preserves owned dense/sparse paths for other inputs. Independent match index and selected token candidates retain their own ownership.
design.capacitySelection: 8N>=4*(1<<18), selected from physical capacity before admission. No fixture identity, remaining-budget snapshot, fallback after refusal, pool, new owner/quota or cross-operation retention.
design.lifecycle: Reserve token array before allocation and keep it charged through matching, parsing and selected output users. Borrow only same-operation Count0/CacheBits0 capacity. Explicit transfer and catch/finally cleanup; rejected repeated tokens still supply trace scratch. ResetForTrace replaced by ResetForReuse without wrappers.
design.contracts: Hash keys, chains, sentinels, matching/parser/candidate order, tie-breaking, integer costs and complete packets unchanged. Existing input/output/dimension/container bounds and bounded direct cancellation remain.

memory.note: Direct per-thread allocation samples and BenchmarkDotNet whole-operation allocation figures are both retained; small harness/diagnostic differences are not exact production savings. Coarse admitted peak excludes borrowed input/caller stream and is not physical heap peak. No CPU gain inferred from allocation reduction.
